Bait that increases the chance of catching rare fish.
A hearty feast that fortifies your body.  Grilled over a fire, this skewer will increase your '''melee damage, boost your maximum health, and accelerate your health regeneration.'''

This mushroom skewer will strengthen not only your flesh but also your mind.  Grilled over a fire, it will raise your '''maximum health, increase your magic damage, and accelerate your mana regeneration.'''

A hunter's favorite ration, crafted for precision.  After you've grilled it over a fire, it will grant you '''more maximum health, increase your ranged and dagger damage, and expand your maximum stamina.'''
Grains of raw rice. They'll be very filling once cooked.
Raw wool. It's fluffy, easily knotted, and smells vaguely earthy. It needs to be processed further to be used for garments and armor.
Roll out the red carpet whenever you wish, and make your entrance in style.
Red - the color of the Flame fitting for a Flameborn!
This block made from polished red marble fragments has a mysterious, yet graceful look.
The simple fragment can be processed into a stunning Red Marble Block.
A building material made from Sandstone, fitting the colors of the desert. It was created for architectural monuments.
A Refined Stone Block, that plastered countless aristocratic buildings back in the day.
Wood of extremely high quality that was manufactured with an eye for detail.
A Regular Sandstone Block. It's very cost - efficient.
A Regular Stone Block used for everyday construction.
Repair your equipment on the go. Gradually restores a small amount of durability over time.
The tough and scaly skin of a reptile.
A sturdy material used in extravagant tailoring.
This protective juice of trees has many functions. First and foremost, serving the cause of the trees!
A mix of soil, rock and sediment.
A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.
The best stories start small. For example with a stone.
A handful of roasted coffee beans. They smell chocolaty and rich, with a light note of floral sweetness. They must be ground up before brewing.
A rugged-looking stone road material made from jagged rocks. Be careful where you step!
An interesting plant, stimulating every persons taste buds. The use in tea has established itself as a custom.
These rough stones shimmer slightly and have a very rustic style.
A rougher version of the Refined Sandstone Block, mainly produced for quantity. Due to its outer appearance it was mainly used for foundations.
A Rough Stone Block built in the most basic manner of craftsmanship.
A basic construction material. Not very pretty, but it gets the job done.
A block made out of rocks extracted from the grounds. Roughly cut to the right size to stack them. Great for building a foundation!
Globular and small, this sea urchin looks unassuming. A keen eye, however, will notice the fivefold symmetry.
The dusty remains of building materials.
Runes attract and store magical energy from all around them. Used to enhance weapons.
A rare herbal plant that can be found in hot areas of the world.
Crystalline powder which can be found in enshrouded valleys. The taste of food can be improved drastically when sprinkled with salt.
Sand, glittering like gold on a hot summers day, is shifty even in the best of hours.
Sandstone are stones that consist mainly out of big sand particles - a beautiful natural material and another wonder of nature to admire.
Hardened scales of wild animals. Some say they are as hard as stone.
A golden jewel scarab beetle. It can be found in the Kindlewastes, and is used as fishing bait, especially useful to catch rare fish.
She is less fearsome when headless. The acidic scent lingers, however.
A strange cluster of sea urchins with varying sizes and shapes. Most of these were harmless ocean dwellers but some carried fatal venom, so it's best to avoid being stung.
The shadowbloom is one of the few plants resistant to the Kindlewastes heat. Their bright orange petals are only visible at night and are used to make vibrant colors.

A sharp tooth from a large aquatic being, possibly a megalodon variant. It's preserved incredibly well and, surprisingly, might be comparatively recent. The owner must've had quite an appetite to need such gigantic teeth...
A type of limestone derived from seashells
This stone block is commonly used in Veilwater Basin.
This is a road material made from shell limestone, wich is commonly found in Vailwater Basin.
A thick, viscius substance harvested from Shroud Flayers. Its tenacious bonding properties make it essential for crafting armor and securely sticking materials together in various crafting recipes.
A stable form of energy. Burning it at the Flame Altar may protect against the Shroud.

A translucent, gelatinous substance extracted from Shroud Depthdwellers. It shimmers with an eerie glow and possesses restorative and protective properties. Essential for crafting healing spells and magical wards.
Shroud infused soil seems dangerous at first glance. However, when used in a controlled environment, it can create a potent bioactive environment that encourages rapid growth.
The liquified essence of the Shroud, harvested from enshrouded growths. The brown fluid emits a violet vapour and is used for many powerful alchemical purposes.
A mushroom that is commonly found in the Shroud of the Revelwood biome.  It's inedible but can be processed into different materials in crafting.
Highly concentrated Shroud energy, bundled in a pulsating core.
Contains a higher Shroud concentration compared to spores.
The Highest concentration of shroud energy, even higher than shroud nexus
Contains a higher Shroud concentration compared to Shroud Particles.
An organic bag containing highly concentrated Shroud spores.
Fine sand that's been infused with Shroud spores.
Vibrant and deeply disturbing if you allow it to invade your mind.
Excessive experimentation proved that mixing slime and jelly creates sludge. All of these substances are entirely different and deserving of their own characterization due to their varied visconsity.
Shroud Spores are particles of energy that create and give the shroud its corrupting power.
A potent base for crafting potions of various kinds.
The wood of Shroud infested trees. Its structure and properties are changed forever.
A wood block made from trees that died a long time ago. They are extremely common in areas of the Shroud.
Citizens of Embervale would sometimes invest in silver in the hope it would hold its value during a crisis. A crisis did come, but the silver offered little help.
Fine, shimmery silver powder. Don't drop it, or you'll find specs of silver in your floorboards for weeks to come.
Silver is a precious metal often found in combination with other minerals. This raw silver ore will need to be processed to become useful.
Very simple fishing bait made out of Critter Parts. Can be used to catch common fish, but not many will like the taste of that one.

A lonely gastropod, sitting peacefully on a rock. Descendants of this variant still populated Embervale's shores until recently. Their colorful shells and slippery mucus were crushed into the iridescent pigment used to dye cloth.
A robust, small sea lily fossil. No matter how you turn it, you're always greeted by a tendril or imprint.
A road material made from smooth stones. Traveling on it is a delight.
Powdery, lily-white snow. The way it drowns out the sounds of chaos makes he world seem just a little more peaceful.
A small amount of essence from the Flame! By feeding it back to the Flame Altar maybe it could become stronger and burn even brighter.
Nobody really knows what it is. They just call it the "Spice". It makes food much more delicious though, so it is highly sought after!

A gland that's seemingly dripping with poison. Don't think about it too much, or the visual will haunt your dreams.  Found on poison-spitting spiders and can be used in crafting to produce an antidote to Hemotoxin.
A mix of soil, rock and sediment.
A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.
A flower with star-shaped petals. It fills the moonlit valleys of the Albaneve Summits with the smell of death.  Its deep, dark color can be used to make pitch-black pigments.
A building block made from polished marble. It's as dark as the night sky.
As an alloy of both iron and carbon, steel possesses better resistance and therefore provides more protection when used in armor.
The best stories start small. For example with a stone.
A natural plant, remains of the agriculture left behind, that grows in the world. It offers protection from the elements when used as building material.
Used to bind things together, String is an extremely important item.
An important material and one of the basic chemical ingredients found within nature.
Not very pretty, but useful when it comes to creating protection from the elements.
A Tarred Wood Block. Now only the shingles are missing.
Weathered stones, either built or claimed by the Vukah. The yellow-tinged moss in the furrows hints at its age.
A reconstructed map, consisting of 4 former map pieces. It depicts a lake with an island, a river, an obelisk, and parts of a large skeleton. The full writing on the back now reads:
A metal used to create bronze. It can be found in the Nomad Highlands.
An ore which contains traces of tin. Needed to create Tin Bars.
Torn and tattered remains of cloth that were left behind and now serve the Scavengers as clothing
A large gland filled with lethal substance. Handle it with care.
Mined from the deadly waste found in the Hollow Halls. Caution is advised!
A detailed trilobite imprint. The structure of its exoskeleton can still be made out clearly.
Multiple ancient trilobites, perfectly still and preserved in a petrified coat of sediment.
This tropical wood can be harvested from ancient trees. It is very sturdy!
A twig, as insignificant as it might seem, has a lot of potential. Everything starts somewhere...
Bait that increases the chance of catching uncommon fish.
An organic growth that glows brightly in the deep, dark waters.
Soft, water-soaked mud, hauled up from the bottom of a lake or silent stream.
A mix of soil, rock and sediment.
A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.
A bright, silvery white sand that mostly consists of crushed seashells.
A sharp, organic stinger. Don't get pricked, or you'll have venom rushing through your veins!
A luscious, dyed fabric, usually reserved for creating the finest garments.
The tusks remain dangerous since they don't dull after death. Never stumble!
A complicated and interwoven nesting material, used for building extravagant tree houses.
A warmer and better-insulated padding kit. When used to create armor, it will protect you from the bitter cold.
This hide is sleek and water-resistant. It's commonly procured from reptiles that prefer wet or water-filled environments.
A shiny material with an interesting texture. Any garment made with this will appear very fashionable.
A common ingredient with a smooth consistency. Needed for illumination of all sorts.
In ancient times, these blocks were used to build dungeons and catacombs. Nowadays, they are in bad condition, but still serve their purpose.
Bathed in waterproofing liquids, this stone block is mostly used for Elixir Wells.
A soaked boot, damaged through years of water exposure. Perhaps the fur on it could be useful.
Both a cooking ingredient and a seed for the fields.
This material glows in a warm white light. It's an alchemical miracle!
A building block crafted from Warm White Glowing Substance. Its radiance brightens up any space.
This byproduct of the Charcoal Kiln has many useful porperties, which can be used in medicine and alchemy.
Planks created by cutting Wood Logs into shape. Very useful for building.
Refined wool. It can be used for weaving garments and warm padding.
Useful for flesh wounds.
Nutritious Yak food for tame animals on your farm.
Food for attracting and taming a Yak.
Yellow dyed fabric used for clothing.
A phosphorizing yellow block that draws your eyes in with whispered promises of wealth and secrecy.
The crystal heart, placed between the wings, pulsates with the cold hunger of the abyss.
A heavy weapon, fit for descending any abyss — both literally and figuratively.
Magical ammunition that sprays acid in a cone in front of the caster, poisoning all enemies hit.
A cleaver coated with acid and bile. Its victims can mend the bleeding — but rarely stop the toxins from spreading.

Only Draklings skilled enough earn the right to wield these adorned daggers. They often remain a trusted weapon for a lifetime.

'''Finesse:'''
The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
This Glider is lighter and enables you to travel bigger distances.
A heavy hammer that strikes true, like a bird of prey.
A ring with glowing blue engravings that read:  "May the Shroud never tear you down — Balthazar"

A primordial wand that speaks of the previous dominion of the Drak. When the Drak'Dal were pushed back to the archipelago after they attacked humanity, their craft degenerated significantly, thus losing the ability to reproduce designs such as this.

'''Overcharge:'''
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the ''overcharge'' percentage.

'''Multishot:'''
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
Designed in admiration of antlers, this bow has an imperial and awe-inspiring image.

The weapon brandishes an interlocking pattern of dark and light by partially covering its fuller with a blackened outer shell. The sword's sides are asymmetric, making one ideal for slashing while the other excels in prying or hacking through its pronounced claw-like appendage.
Modified to increase the mana control, this wand shoots ice projectiles with a bit more force.
A bow that sparks blazing joy in firebugs and aspiring pyromaniacs.
All incoming light fractures on the surface of this elegant blade, creating a dancing ensemble of floating colors. It is practically dripping with excellence.
When placed in competent hands, this horned bow can fire a shot so powerful that it may loosen an avalanche, and bury the valleys in everlasting snow.
A primitive tool used for cutting wood. It can also be used as a weapon in a pinch.
A infested [[Shroud]] bow, able to teach the true meaning of pain.
Miscreants, brutes, and evil doers of the past would often wield similar blades. Perhaps this weapon was forged in the shadows of a back alley and changed hands on the black market.
An elegant dual dagger set with extravagant gold detailing. It's slim enough to be smuggled underneath a nightgown unseen into any chamber.
A heavy two-handed hammer that can break through any door thanks to the added front spikes. Bashing, tearing, and slashing are no problem for this weapon!
The blades of this axe have sharp edges that flow into an upper peak. They were crafted like that to break through frozen lake surfaces or walls and resemble bat wings.
Every apprentice knows that the Blackened Staff hides dark secrets. Trying to uncover them leads to migraines, nausea, and paranoia.
A wand that deals significant fire damage, eradicating anything in its path.
A club that was bathed in divine waters, thus acquiring a blessing of protection. Turns out blessings are less effective than cold, hard steel when caught in an ambush.
Striking in the blink of an eye, these daggers can slash any throat quickly and quickly.
This colossal axe draws strength from those it wounds, stealing their vitality with each strike.
A dull set of daggers. Simple, but still efficient in a pinch.
An arrow made from bone.
Call upon the forces of the underworld to summon projectiles that seek out enemies.
Hold to summon bone projectiles that seek out enemies with a devastating force.
A primitive, but well-crafted brutal weapon to splinter the bones of the enemy.
This mace is the bane and banisher of all undead creatures.
An axe forged from shadowy steel crowned with a single, slimmed gemstone. The grip is mantled with boreal wood.
An important bow made out of basic materials. Unfortunately, the bowstring is quite loose.
A strong bow that frames each shot in between two serpent's maws. Let your arrows strike with the calculated savagery of a viper in waiting!
The goat head imprinted on this metal shield is imposing, looking down on its adversaries with a stalwart gaze.
A club with long, protruding spikes forged from moon-bathed steel. Spilled blood is easily visible on this weapon.
Every true shot makes the blood pump faster.
An advanced arrow with a bronze tip.
An axe with a bronze head. Sturdier than the Copper version.
A pickaxe made out of bronze. Only struggling with the hardest of stones, it can be considered very efficient.
A light and swift sword of beautiful color. It dulls quickly, though.

These daggers are adorned with crystal inlays shaped like eyes, a constant reminder to their wielders that the Broodmother Vesztah watches them at all times. It is believed that she guides their hand - ensuring that only the strongest may hatch, while the weak are struck down by the blade's edge.

''' Finesse: '''
The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
You can take screenshots with this item.
A small campfire to cook food that can give many bonuses. It's a great spot to take a rest and relax.
An ice-cold axe with a central, vibrant gem. Its blades are adorned with small spikes to cause maximum damage. When this axe rains down on its enemies, it beautifully reflects the sun's light.
Improved magical ammunition that releases a healing wave and jumps to nearby friends.
Magical ammunition to release a powerful lightning strike that shocks enemies and jumps to others nearby, dealing additional '''stamina damage'''.
A hefty two-handed axe, usually wielded by champions of the ring! Axes like these are often a status symbol and represent triumph.
Those who wield the Chief Drak'Dal Axe command great awe - one swing is enough to bring a tribe to its knees. It's taken many lives, and lusts for countless more.

An elaborate weapon adorned with prized horns, probably trophies from past hunts. At times, the Drak would make sacrifices to their gods in Ark Morgo to channel their elemental affinities. Therefore, this axe of a tribal chief was imbued with the power of lightning to aid in their pursuits.
A pair of circus knives that can do a lot of damage if left in untrained hands! Better watch out!
A ceremonial staff, used in part to melt frozen lakes into clear, drinkable water.
A club carved out of wood. Not much, but better than nothing.
The wielder's energy melts inside the wand's empty husk and reforms to shoot forth a boundless stream of elemental energy.
This wand grants power over ice to whoever is brave enough to wield it.
This is a very sophisticated bow with hight tension.
An arrow with a copper tip
A sharp Copper Axe which is highly efficient at cutting wood. It can also be used to cut down enemies.
A decent tool forged out of copper. At least working does not become a hassle because of bad equipment.
These blades were corroded by being submerged in poison for too long.
Fire proves to be an excellent weapon against creatures of the [[Shroud]].

A Shroud-tainted wand which radiates darkness. You feel that using it will widen a hidden void beneath Embervale, slowly growing in obscurity, swallowing all around...but perhaps using it once or twice won't hurt?
A strange wand which was covered by ashes. Its body bends and twists, but never breaks.
A crystalline frame lines the edges of these short blades. They shift incoming light and reflect it, bathing the daggers in the color of fresh mountain springs.
A staff that imbues the wielder with the ability to melt ice capes and frozen streams. The resulting fresh water is considered exceptionally pure and healing.
Its maw is cradling a gem that glows as the curse is spoken, leaving foes weaker as it feeds itself.
A rudimentary set of daggers, the secondary weapon of choice for archers.
Cleave through it all. Part the Shroud. Excise the tumor.

Children rumored that people killed by this Morningstar would have their souls banished inside the orb. These remnants would echo aimlessly forever in their spherical prison, bouncing between the curved walls and the void.
A magical staff, utilizing the power of darkness to cast stronger magic spells. A mighty tool feared by every sorcerer. {{About Staves}}
This is an elevated version of the Boreal Axe. Its head boasts an intricate design, typical for northern craftsmanship.
A staff that harnesses the power of the eclipsed sun. It functions best when only a crescent of light is left.
A wand that harnesses the power of the eclipse. It functions best when the sun is fully submerged in darkness, and only a faint rim of light shines through.
Its crystal eye watches the battlefield, and thoses it fixes upon rarely see another dawn.
The weapon of choice for the deceitful.
Carved from foraged dead wood and dusty roots, this axe was hardened in the sun to tear flesh and split bones.
This draconic-looking bow was often feared for its crooked horns of unknown origin. Villagers believed that horns so twisted would always bring bad luck.
Crafted to resemble the wings of the most infamous Kindlewastes, the Draconian Vulture.
A mythical blade from long gone days. Legends say that it was passed on to Embervale by a wise spirit who descended from the stars in the year of the dragon.
Gain the strength of a dragon with this legendary weapon.

An axe found atop the skull of a giant dragon skeleton.  Legends say it was used to slay the mother dragon, but it wasn't lodged inside her cranium when you found it.    That's probably for the best. Mothers have enough headaches already.

This bow was fashioned after the likeness of the Drak'Dal, even though they don't use such weapons themselves. An arrow shot from this bow will split the air like the sharp whistle of the drakian tongue.
Ridges line the base of this sword, adding weight to each swing. The uneven silhouette is reminiscent of protruding vertebrae.

These daggers mark the next stage for young Drak after training with bamboo sticks. Their compact size makes them easy to wield even from an early age. '''Finesse:''' The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
A large and powerful hammer that has been corrupted by the [[Shroud]]. Good for smashing bugs!
Rays of steel stretch outward from the sword handle's guard. They resemble the final light of the sun before an eclipse.
A magic staff, brimming with the power of its former owner. Legend has it that the elder's soul is linked to it, sometimes humming at night. {{About Staves}}
A burning sword, glowing with power. It burns hot enough to reduce the mana of its prey with every hit.
The most basic weaponry, enhanced to be more effective and durable.
A mighty axe wich lusts for blood.
Banned in most mystic circles, this spell serves as an infinite well of acid to envenom foes. It's bite is most deadly, so use with care
An eternal spell which distributes great healing that jumps to nearby friends.

An eternal spell which releases a powerful lightning strike that shocks nearby enemies and jumps to others nearby.

'''Eternal Spell:''' Does '''not deplete.''' Equip the Eternal spell and use '''mana''' to cast it with a '''staff.'''

This spell is fueled by the eternal Flame and serves as unlimited magical ammunition to ignite a mighty fireball that erupts upon impact, dealing damage in a large area.

'''Eternal Spell:''' Does '''not deplete.''' Equip the Eternal spell and use '''mana''' to cast it with a '''staff.'''

Superior magical ammunition to ignite a mighty fireball that erupts upon impact, dealing damage in a medium area.

'''Eternal Spell:''' Does '''not deplete.''' Equip the Eternal spell and use '''mana''' to cast it with a '''staff.'''
An arrow that was touched by eternity. It's ice cold to the touch.
An arrow that was touched by eternity. It's ice cold to the touch.

Continuously heal a target in a beam up to 20 meters away.

'''Channel Spell:''' Hold the input to channel '''over time.''' Equip the spell and use '''mana''' to cast it with a '''staff.'''

'''Eternal Spell:''' Does '''not deplete.''' Equip the Eternal spell and use '''mana''' to cast it with a '''staff.'''
An eternal spell which heals all allies in need.
An eternal version of the Ice Bolt. The spell damages enemies upon impact and slows them afterwards.
An eternal version of the Ice Bolt. The spell damages enemies upon impact and slows them afterwards.
This eternal is imbued with the power of light. When cast, a bright burst of radiance flashes before you and pushes back enemies.
Umlimited magical ammunition that continuously channels powerful lightning strikes. It shocks enemies by jumping between them and deals stamina damage.
This magic shield allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
This ring will increase your health and healing rate.
This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.
An ancient ring that gives you stamina.
An axe of gruesome origin. It has seen many heads roll and still fulfills its purpose today.
A sword with a reinforced, pointed edge that can cut through any growth in the thicket. The blade is also useful for hunting wildlife.
A special arrow that delivers an explosive surprise.
A special arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with improved firepower.
A '''special arrow''' that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with greatly improved firepower.
Although no longer enflamed this formerly magical sword still has a sharp edge.
This Glider will allow you to travel extraordinarily long distances.
The edge of these daggers is shaped like the break of a soaring eagle, willing to strike down toward its enemies
This blade is razor-sharp like the fangs of the terrifying creatures that prowl the Nomad Highlands.
This club strikes fear into the hearts of your foes with every swing
Designed after the fletching of an arrow, this weapon shows true brutality when smiting friend or foe.
A heavy sword wielded by armored Fell.
Forged for ruthless efficiency, the Fell Commander Bow finds its purpose in the skulls of Scavengers who dare cross its path.
Pierce enemies in the back with arrows shot from this precise Fell Impaler Bow, perfect for those who prefer their enemies dealt with from a comfortable distance.
A sturdy shield carried by the Fell. It has held up for ages.
An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.
Magical ammunition that ignites a firebolt, dealing damage to a single target.
Magical ammunition that ignites a fireball, erupting upon impact and dealing damage in a small area.
Advanced magical ammunition to ignite a mighty fireball that erupts upon impact, dealing damage in a medium area.
Superior magical ammunition to ignite a mighty fireball that erupts upon impact, dealing damage in a medium area.
Scouting ahead can be quite challenging, especially in the dark. The Flare Arrow leaves a flare at the point of impact, spending a little light.
The needles of this spiked club can tenderize countless meat bags to mush.
A slightly enhanced version of the Wooden Arrow, reinforced with small pieces of flint at the tip.
This bow has great tension, making it exhausting to use. It does greate damage in exchange.
Lost and forgotten amidst the [[Shroud]], this bow unleaches fury on anyone that crosses its path.
An arrow enhanced with pieces of Fossilized Bone. Strikingly beautiful and deadly.

When a drakling hatches from its shell, its lowered, elongated body appears almost snake-like. However, they soon adapt an upright posture and bare their teeth this process is represented through the design of this mace.
Every aspect of this hammer's head is designed meticulously. The front and back boast a colorful yet distinguished design, while the sides share a row of spikes. Appealing, and functional.
A wand that focuses a wielder's power through a frozen crystal. Magical energy is refracted inside and amplified with every reflection.

Legends say that this weapon was once wielded by a hero who was mangled in battle. He sought a freezing cave to rest and tend to his wounds, leaving a trail of blood in the snow. Once he emerged after a hundred-year slumber, a swarm of ice bats soared into the night sky, signaling his return.
This wand hides a rare frozen core inside, enabling its owner to unleash massive ice damage against foes.
Attacking while in the air spawns +6 projectiles that home towards your target and deal 17 piercing damage.

A formidable Glider which can cross even the deepest trenches, allowing you to rain death from above.
This magic shield allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
An arrow made from giant bone.
A steel axe, decorated with gold accents. It makes you feel much stronger, although the blade itself is most likely not improved by much.
This steel pickaxe has been further refined through the addition of gold ornaments.
A magical staff that gleams with hope, able to unleash powerful magical attacks. {{About Staves}}
The possibility to fly has always been a desirable trait.
A hammer that has been further improved by an added goat horn in the back. Only the finest, most sturdy horns are selected.
A massive golden shield engraved with the snarling face of an ancient creature. Its fanged visage is said to ward off evil and strike fear into enemies on the battlefield.

The most successful, newly decorated recruits are sometimes gifted weapons dipped in gold. They aren't any sharper than their less impressive counterparts, but serve as a status symbol among the group.
A refined steel-tipped arrow embellished with gold. With this, you can fight in style.

Many soldiers fall in war. Those who return are heralded and showered in gold and gifts; given weapons befitting a celebrated veteran... but for some, such gifts merely serve as a reminder of their harrowing past.
A deadly club that will decimate any enemy.
A sturdy tool that can help to cross many chasms along the way.
Carved with a stone visage, this axe is as much relic as weapon.
An elaborate sword, decorated in gold filigree. It came from the skies as a shooting star years ago, and fell into the gasping maw of a cave.
This ring will increase your health and healing rate.
This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.
An ancient ring that gives you stamina.

An electrically charged, two-handed axe, able to release sparks into the overcast sky when striking. It was struck by lightning while inside a cataclysmic typhoon and survived, unlike its previous owner.
Before the fall, many guards and knights of Embervale would brandish swords such as these. Perhaps their spirit lives on through your fighteous strikes.
A pair of dark, grey daggers adorned with a bright green gem the color of envy.

Lord Vorgoth's once-trusted blade was discarded before the war and replaced by a weapon more befitting of vile acts. It still clings to a semblance of sanity and light, shining brightly in the dark like the North Star.
It's more than a shield - it's a bulwark of faith, a final sanctuary in the fray.
Heads plummet to the ground, eyes shut in terror. Victims prefer darkness rather than to face the Guillotine.
A blade that's cold to the touch. It weighs heavily on the mind.
This axe is eerily percise. The hair on your arms stands up as you wield it.
Step only where you remain unseen, strike those whose eyes are blinded by your glint in the half-light.
A set of crystal eyes adorns this weapon, seeking the weak points of your foes. The handle has been decorated with overlapping leather straps.
A versatile one handed axe. Frequently used to split the skulls of enemies.
A gigantic hammer that can only be wielded with both hands. The head was forged from one solid block of steel, requiring advanced crafting techniques.
Continuously heal a target in a beam up to 20 meters away.
Magical ammunition that, upon use, releasing continuous healing projectiles.
A perplexing wand, corrupted by the [[Shroud]]. It bends the mind of its bearer.
This basic shield allows you to block physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
Unyielding and unbroken, this staff resembles the realm's last bastion of hope.
The many layers of smelted metal in these daggers make them appear similar to an animal's tiered horn, tapering off at the edges.
A bow crafted to resemble the horned beasts of the Albaneve Summits. It makes for a fearsome silhouette.
Sharp extensions jut out from the blade's periphery: an assortment of stingers, sharpened flint, and horns. A strike from this jagged edge will rip and tear almost anything.
A finely handcrafted bow, used by seasoned woodland hunters.
An ancient ring that gives you stamina.
A blade that seems to be forged from ice itself.
Magical ammunition that creates a single bolt of ice, damaging enemies upon impact and slowing them afterwards.
Improved ammunition that creates a single bolt of ice, damaging enemies upon impact and slowing them afterwards.

The tip of these daggers has become permanently frosted after piercing the ice-cold heart of a Cyclops. Either that or someone tried their hand at spearfishing and left their blades in the freezing waters too long.
A sleek silvery sword, slim and reflective like a pure icicle.
Ignited by the [[Flame]] itself, this bow pulse with the power of fire.
Inheriting the power of the Flame, this hammer can break through lines of enemies easily.
Requires less stamina. Can be activated at larger ranges.
Marked through hundreds of hours of enduring the force of fire, this wand has a connection to the element and is able to utilize it.
This magic shield allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
A deadly arrow tipped with an iron arrowhead, spreading fear among enemies
An axe with a very sturdy iron head. It's more efficient!
A mace that easily cleaves through toes like a pack of starving wolves.
A highly performant pickaxe made out of iron, useful in every environment. A truly handy tool to have.
A savage weapon of black glass. The blade seems almost alive, dark as the void and sharp as Drak scales.
An axe that carves a path through enemies no matter what. Swinging it fearlessly makes it feel light as a feather.
An extension to your backpack that increases your inventory by a lot.
A weapon that was rumored to have fallen from the stars. The man who found it could never feel whole, always searching for a missing piece.
This ring will increase your health and healing rate.
This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.
An ancient ring that gives you stamina.
Magical ammunition that releases a flash of light, bright enough to push back enemies around the caster.
An axe forged in pure light. Few have witnessed its glory, and those who did were blinded in a flash.
Daggers that were bathed in sunlight during forging. Their spiked edge can cause a lot of damage
Magical ammunition that continuously channels powerful lightning strikes. It shocks enemies by jumping between them and deals '''stamina damage'''.
Opens a lock
An axe to end any battle quickly.
This wand grants power over fire to whoever is brave enough to wield it.
"Shadow Over Umber Hollow -- Lupa" is etched on the side.

It was customary in the far North to carry the dead to their graves while brandishing a steel mace. This presentation of stalwart strength in the face of death and terror would ward off evil spirits and guide the dead safely to the Northwinds of the afterlife.
In the bygone days, young men would carry maces like these to thrash and toil amongst one another like a dark, thundering storm. It helped to release anger and to weed out the weak.
Don't let the image deceive you. It might look like a mace, but it's a primitive club after all.
Create a magical barrier that protects from projectiles and reduces melee damage taken.
Archaic power sleeps within this blade. It resonates, whispers and sings to those who dare to listen.
A long pair of daggers with cloth around the handle.
Striking with staggering force, this hammer obliterates the [[Hollow Halls|Hollow]] by grinding their bones to dust.
A large hammer, made from a combination of rock and steel. The mix of materials makes it especially heavy.
A primitively crafted but brutal weapon, awaiting its next prey.
An extension to your backpack that increases your inventory size by a sizeable amount.
You see it before your inner eyes: A giant, submerged in the deep ocean blue, controlling the tides with each laboring, drawn-out exhale. The depths are calling. Will you answer?
A shield that will provide safety and aid. For a price.
A six-edge mace made from heavy metal. The head of this weapon resembles a star.
Archaic power vibrates deep within this sword.
All hope is fickle, a mirage on the horizon. This staff makes its bearer reject all convictions to walk into the abyss.
No matter how dire the night may be, with the rising sun comes sweet morning dew.
A shield with a central amethyst. The metal frame around the sides makes it more durable.
Many amethyst stones were used to forge this wand. They are needed to prevent combustion when this weapon inevitably overheast from the bundled energy inside!
A dagger set made from darkened steel, reflecting the moonlight on its fractured edges.
A mystical pair of blades used for unspeakable divinations held under the full moon.
A bow that's fueled by the dark shimmer of the [[Shroud]].
A dignified blade, used to defend the honor and lives of the weak.
This sword, bright and blinding, erupts on the battlefield to unleash the original brilliance of the Flame.
These are only a few ways to flee a promise you don't intend to keep. At least one of them involves murder.
An arrow tipped with a sharp shard of Obsidian.
''"Gaze into the orb,"'' the Oracle said, eyes fixated on her staff. ''"It shows the past, the present, and the future  and they're all veiled in blue rot".''

The embellishments on this sword seem inspired by eastern craftsmanship, but the choice of material betrays the maker's origin. This weapon was most likely forged by a well-traveled blacksmith or commissioned by an aristocrat.
A top-quality bow inspired by antlers. One might call it art.
These spiky daggers were often worn by soldiers around their belts during parades as a show of force. Sometimes, children are gifted a simpler version as their first weapon.
A basic mining tool, made of the simplest of materials. It's not very durable or efficient, but does what it's supposed to do.
Even in death, the queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield.
A practical and quick bow made from humble pine wood. Its tensions is weak, so using it require little stamina.
A '''special arrow''' laced with poison, making it even deadlier.
A Copper Arrow laced with poison, making it even deadlier.
This golden, steel-tipped arrow has been dipped in poison. A strike with this will be most deadly.
A special arrow lanced in poison, perfect for hunting.
A steel arrow lanced in poison, perfect for hunting.
A wand the especially talented scholars of the arcane forces favor. It's versatile and reflects the wielder's brilliance.
This magic shield allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
Daggers with many edges and sharp hooks. They can be whipped out in the blink of an eye to parry incoming attacks, thus defending your honor.
A provisional tool used to deal fast and ugly cuts.
The Pyreblade is capable of unleashing devastating fire strikes while reflecting a portion of the foe's own fury back upon them.
The bow curves into a zig-zag on both sides, capturing a vision of a rattlesnake's tail in motion.
A twisted wand emitting a faint, blue light. It demands to be wielded!

A simplified wand, shaped by the resurgence of the Drak. Weapons such as these would've held great power in the past, but the primal knowledge surrounding their creation was lost. Recently crafted wands are therefore more primitive, and mere imitations of the once undeniable power and dominion of the beasts.
It hugs your finger like an icy embrace and lets you become one with the cold. It imbues the wearer with increased frost resistance.
This ring will increase your health and healing rate.
This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.
A glimmering ring, plucked from the remains of someone who got more than they bargained for.
An ancient ring that gives you stamina.
An amazing work of art, beauty and power.
Filled with the burning Spark of the Flame, it's a valuable asset in the fight against the Shroud. It increases the time you can withstand the Shroud.

A ring that radiates affluence and tragedy. Was it freed from the ivory finger of a friend, a brother, a child of fortune? Could its fealty have been betrayed, its blood promise broken? Whatever story this ring may tell, its former lords are long gone.

Sometimes, when the tropical winds of the Veilwater Basin roll towards the cold air of the mountains, a thundersnow is born.  The snowfall softens its roars, but it leaves traces in the freshly cracked surfaces of frozen ponds.
A shield that was washed into a grotto by the river. Must have belonged to a valiant hero.
Even a simple shield such as this can save your life when you get surrounded, or surprised.
This ceremonial wand was often used when praying for drownpours when the drought first started. While that didn't work, you can still use it to call lightning down on your enemies.
A light shield that effortlessly allows the wearer to stay nimble whilst under fire.
This staff was made from the roots of an age-old tree. Wisdom and calm flow through it. {{About Staves}}
The [[Shroud]] slumbers inside. Rotblood is molded by it, changed, and its essence forever tinted.
A broad and imposing axe. If you want to leave a fearsome impression, this weapon  will do the trick.

The simplicity of this sword is deceiving! A faint, magical power radiates from the pastel blue stone forged into the blade. This craftsmanship was very popular with young spell slingers and battle mages.
The inscription carved into this sword cannot be deciphered, since the archaic knowledge of rune matching has been lost to time. Whatever the writing entails, it makes the blade overflow with energy.
A forgotten sword from long gone days. Commonly found among the ashes of Embervale.
A rusted Simple Copper Sword, damaged by time itself. Its best days are far gone.
A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual.
A blade forged from the stolen steel of fallen soldiers. It spreads regret and misery.
A dagger set of old-timey Eastern craftmanship. Rogues of that era would swing this short cutlass around during battle, causing nearby sand to swirl up and blind the enemy.
This Scavenger Miner Axe wil llet you pry ore from stone by day and pierce traitors' backs by night.

Scholars of the North once researched the use of pyro magic against particularly harsh winters. It took countless explosive experiments to discover the same benefit most people might achieve with a bonfire. Downsides such as third-degree burns were common, so research was quickly stopped.
This wand practically vibrates with warmth and destructive energy. It becomes restless and twitchy when dormant for too long.
A slightly enhanced version of the Wooden Arrow, reinforced with a piece of scrap metal at the tip.
An axe made out of scrap metal with improved durability and efficiency compared to the Axe
Forged from old metal rests, it shows signs of improvement in performance, but still does not deserve to be called a handy tool.
A blunt sword, designed to open up ways. Especially through lines of enemies.
An accurate bow imbued with the mysterious powers of the [[Shroud]].
A broadsword almost too big to be comfortably swung. The original owner must have been gigantic.

Sometimes a Drak hatchling proves too weak to break its shell. In such cases, the Broodwardens use this poison-tipped blade to cut the egg open. The young bear a mark from that day onward — a symbol of frailty that brands them for life, forever beneath those who hatched unaided. '''Finesse:''' The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
A mighty relic, able to provide solace amidst chaos. The previous owner might have been retired hero. {{About Staves}}
A potent staff capable of guiding those who would otherwise be without protection. {{About Staves}}
This makeshift shield allows you to block physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
This sacred shield consecrated by the Flame allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
A frosty set of daggers said to be infused with the souls of those who died in the coldest winters.
A dagger set that was scavenged from the ruins of the old world. It's dirty and dusty, but still doas the trick.
Summons an electrified wisp that follows you around and shoots shock projectiles.
Crafted through a combination of lightning and ice. Two powerful elements clash with each other.
A blunt sword, designed to open up ways. Especially through lines of enemies.
If you can't beat them, join them. This arrow uses the power of the Shroud and disperses a cloud of it upon impact.
If you can't beat them, join them. This '''special arrow''' uses the power of the Shroud and disperses a cloud of it upon impact.
Hold to deal continuous Shroud damage in a beam of up to 20 meters range.
A mighty hammer, corrupted to the core. The power of the [[Shroud]] is channeled in the weapon.
Magical ammunition that calls a disastrous Shroud Meteor down on up to five foes. The meteors deal heavy Shroud damage.
A malicious staff that effortlessly intertwines the strings of fate with the Shroud.
This magical wand fires projectiles that deal Shroud damage.
Lightning and ice fuse together to unleash a groundbreaking force.
A bow that aims to strike the heart of the dark with silver-tipped arrows and no hesitation.
A ritualistic staff that was cleansed in a still rivulet under a crescent moon. It servers the wielder to guide the undead back to the beyond.
The Skull Splitter gets its name from its merciless nature - cleaving skulls with every swing.
These daggers are sleek and swift. The blade is sharp as ever.
An extension to your backpack that enlarges your inventory a little.
A mythical wand formed around a winding vertebrae core. It strikes with deadly precision.
This bow is so precise it can split a faraway snowflake in two.
Thrust yourself into battle and glory with the protection of this shield!
A hammer adorned with an ancient petrified tusk. Tusk and teeth
This magic shield allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
The shots from this spiked bow can pierce anything.
A slightly improved version of the club, reinforced with spikes.
Every rose has thorns - and sometimes, nature can serve as inspiration for weaponry and design!

Rectangular flints reach outwards from the blade's core, some as big as your fist. Their peaks and valleys make up the image of a gargantuan spine befitting an apex predator - hence the reference to the drakian god who strove for dominion of the continent.
A menacing axe that sends shivering chills down its victim's back with every heavy two-handed swing.
A basic magical staff that is powered by the wielder's spirituality. {{About Staves}}
A simple magical staff made from calcified bone. Rudimentary, but effective.
Use this staff to burn a path for your herd through the frozen wastes and help them conquer the iciest rivulets and rockiest cliffs.
The mandibles of the staff open towards the skies like a snapjaw's maw, looking to drag prey down to the depths of the moor... Powerful magic cast through this weapon can damn anyone to darkness.
A sublime staff that carries an eerie visage and blank stare. Its face seems as if it were looking up at you from beneath the motionless surface of a black moor.
A horned staff that has been embellished with alabaster fur. It is soft to the touch.
A majestic staff topped with an ouroboros ornament made from green jade. It's perfect for honoring the year of the snake.
A staff that awakes slumbering anger inside the wielder. The protruding amethyst spikes help to channel the emotion towards enemies.
An arrow with a steel tip.
This improved tool will lose durability more slowly thanks to its steel cutting blade. Be careful with your fingers while woodworking!
An axe with two perfectly rounded, balanced steel blades. They nearly form the shape of the full moon.
This pickaxe can help you dig deeper and further due to having been forged from steel. Heave ho!
A once pristine weapon. Now decayed but still just as deadly.

The staff's material is engraved with countless labyrinthine lines reminiscent of the chaotic flow of battle. However, a metal halo encircles the negative space within, preserving a sense of calm, as if one were inside the eye of a storm.
Deals no damage but hits a target with massive force to stun them. Stun time depends on the enemy's size.
An axe that shines brightest at dawn, clinging on to hope no matter what.
A scorching hot blade infused with the desert heart. It can melt both snow and skin.
A well-crafted shield marked by a golden sun. Strong, reliable, and radiant — built to hold the line when all else falters.
This ring will increase your health and healing rate.
This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.
An ancient ring that gives you stamina.
A bright and mighty weapon emanating power.
A glistening green blade, perfectly balancing the aesthetics of betrayal with the spirit of the Lunar New Year
A mighty one-handed axe, tainted by the blood of the fallen.
A bow used by Commanders of the Northen Guard. A powerful energy flows through the user, increasing their pulse and allowing for faster shots.
This bow's natural resistance to fire makes it perfect for firing volleys of flamming arrows.
Instead of exploiting the ruins of forgotten times, you vow to protect them - to uphold their sanctity for reverence not only today, but tomorrow.
A fine pair of twin daggers meant to pierce arteries with precision and grace.
This one-handed axe crakles with electrifying energy since it was charged by lightning during a rare desert storm.
An extension to your backpack that enlarges your inventory by one row.

A standard, carved bow that reminds you of forgotten temples and overgrown tombs. Makes you want to go exploring for hidden riches!

Grave robbing is bad, and you shouldn't do it while anyone is looking.

A staff that was used by magical torchbearers of bygone days. They'd illuminate uncharted caves to claim even the furthest corners of the Albaneve Summits as parts of the northern empire. The scouting went well until the Cyclopes learned that the torchbearers were feeble mages whose light could be snuffed out easily with a decisive boulder toss.
A totem's grimace decorates this wand, watching your every move... sometimes, it empowers your magic. Sometimes, you feel it waiting for your downfall.
A ghastly visage is carved into the mace, looking down on your foes as you smash them into the ground.
A mace with a segmented body, reminiscent of a totem pole climbing towards the sky. The head is augmented with a stone crown that radiats outward.
This bow fires easily against creatures of the Shroud
This magic shield allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
A common hammer that may have once been used by ancient Drak'Dal tribemembers. Its simple design speaks to its utilitarian nature.
A perfectly balanced mace, where each front mirrors the opposite side.
Fire a projectile that deals Shroud damage.
This ring will increase your health and healing rate.
This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.
An ancient ring that gives you stamina.
A staff that absorbs energy from the soil. It's brimming with potential. {{About Staves}}
A grappling hook that can be used underwater.
This basic shield allows you to block physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
A dagger that can easily be hidden undermeath lavish sleeves or dressy skirts. It's quick and easy to unshelth in times of need!
A wild and withered staff, able to unleash the power of the earth. {{About Staves}}
Every swing of this axe leaves a tear in the veil that separates the living from the beyond
A deviously poisoned set of daggers that meander like the slithering body of a [[Kindlewastes]] Diamondback snake.
Two mirrored Drak are represented on this mace. Despite being outwardly similar, they may not share the same fate - for the Broodmother's duality demands the weak become a feast for the strong.

Spikes disrupt the smooth surface and jut forward like razor blades. They spring from within a center of calm, from the storm's eye, as devastating violet rain on a thunderous night - after which all weakness will be cleansed, and only the strongest may rise from the submerged lands. According to folklore, this symbolizes the origin of the drakian Broodmother Vesztah.

A Shroud-tainted wand which radiates darkness. You feel that using it will widen a hidden void beneath Embervale, slowly growing in obscurity, swallowing all around...but perhaps using it once or twice won't hurt?
An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.
A magical wand carved out of bones. Lifeless and cold, it shoots magical ice projectiles.
Winding grooves carve through the body of the wand, creating a canal for extracting the lifeblood of your enemies. Their energy will fuel you long after they've passed.
This sword slices through the air like a sharp howl at midnight.
A naturalistic dagger set with wooden handles. The blades are slightly curved and are ideal for skinning animals.
This sturdy oak wood bow has a high rate of fire and conserve your energy at the expense of damage.
The arrow's shadow darts across the battlefield. Its presence is swift and fleeting, a daydream carried by a gust of wind — but its impact is precisely devastating.
This dagger pair is adorned with a wolf head detail, representing its ferocious strike.
This Axe is destined to smite down creatures of the wild.
Strikes with force and leaves devastating wounds. A weapon truly fitting its name.
An oval shield with a regal aura. When your enemies see your eyes peak up from the safety of the shield, they are merely seconds away from taking their last breath.
A heavy club adorned with multiple wolf heads near the handle.
A blade that devours foes easily. It carved its name into countless bodies in battle.
This fine longbow is exhausting to use, but it strikes with the ferocity of a wolf.
A wooden Arrow made of the most basic ingredients.
Even a simple shield such as this can save your life when you get surrounded, or surprised.
A traditional and excellently carved wooden hammer made by [[Vukah]] craftmens. Resembles a large tooth and is very good at removing such.
These algae may look inconspicuous, but they are highly versatile.
These are the buds of an algae plant. They're inedible when raw, but can be dried.
An algae salad that tastes fresh and vaguely salty, like the sea. Something so green and natural must be healthy.
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil.
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
An antidote that instantly cures any poison effect.
A beautiful yellow flower with magical properties that increases the user's mana.
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
The Azure Russula — an ancient mushroom, existing and consuming magic since the beginning of time. Unfortunately inedible if not cooked.
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
A ripe, yellow banana. It can be eaten raw or used in another dish — without the peel, of course.
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested repeatedly.
This item heals 40% health over 10 seconds if applied to a wound. Receiving any damage interrupts the healing effect.
A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.
A burning hot, meaty stew. Increases your resistance against extreme cold and improves your health and health regeneration.
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
A crisp, vibrant red bell pepper with a sweet, juicy flavor and a glossy skin.

A freshly brewed cup of coffee. The flavor is strong, bold, and lightly acidic. What better way to start the day?
Simple but nourishing. Boosts regeneration in all areas.
Creamy butter with milky richness-perfect for bringing depth and tenderness to your baked creations.
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
A refreshing jug of buttermilk. With its lightly sour flavor and silky texture, it’s very refreshing.
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil.
A soup made from various vegetables and calla luna flowers. It glows in the dark and extends your time in the Shroud!
Peppery, sweet, and packing a punch - this candied ginger is a great snack for anyone not afraid of strong flavours.
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
A very healthy beverage that helps the body recover and prepare for the day to come.
It tastes incredibly bitter when raw, but develops a zesty aroma while cooked.
A very healthy soup made by boiling chicken for a period of time. An old house maiden's dish to help protect the body from illness
Restores 60% of health over 10 seconds. Stops when damage is received.
A cold smoothie made from coconuts and bananas. Best served with a little decorative umbrella, a cozy spot on the beach, and two swirly straws.
This creamy coconut milk makes for a great refreshment on a sunny day by the shore! It can also be used as an ingredient in cooking.
A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested repeatedly.
A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested repeatedly.
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
A delicious jug of Fae Deer milk. Drinking it will grant you endurance and recharge your stamina faster!
This cooked rice is delicious and vaguely aromatic. It will make for a good side dish.
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
A very versatile crop that can be dried, grilled or consumed raw, strengthening the consumer for a short duration.
A delicacy of the marine world, it is crispy on the outside and soft and full of flavor on the inside. It is the perfect meal for weary adventurers.
You should only eat crab meat when it is grilled, as this is the best way to prepare it.
A local delicacy with a creamy texture and rich taste. It fills the belly and heals the soul, especially when the north winds are howling outside.

The Crimsonback, once a common Silverback that survived countless migrations, has scales that burn with a deep red hue. It is said to embody strength and endurance, and it is prized by seasoned anglers for its power and beauty.  It can be eaten raw, but will be even more beneficial when processed further.
A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
A flask brewed from rare underwater materials, easing the strain of every powerful stroke.
A dark concoction distilled from enemy remains. It unveils the writings of their kin and sharpens your blade against them.
These conserved banana chips do not regenerate as much health as the raw fruit. However, the duration of their effect lasts longer - and the crunch is nice too.
When conserved, the Dried Purple Berry do not regenerate as much Health as the Purple berries. However, the duration lasts longer.
Unnerving goo. It bestows great powers on those who eat it.
A great source of protein that enhances the muscle mass. Best consumed before a good exercise.
This Elixir of the Shroud contains great power.... at a cost.
This striking red fish is marked with black stripes. Its shimmering scales resemble cooling embers, earning it the name "Emberfin".
A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.
Even the most carefully cooked Ectoplasm Soup still tastes a little bit...fermented.
The most different experiences gathered and described on a scroll. Gain a small amount of experience based upon absorption of the content.
Removes Fell Curse upon use.  Also applies a buff that prevents the curse from affecting the user for an hour.
The scroll summons a Fire Wisp that follows, assists you in battle and provides light.
A hearty, creamy soup made with tender chunks of fish and fresh vegetables.
Fish cut into thick slices, be aware of the the bones, but you can still enjoy it.
The Filet of an epic fish, don't worry about any fish bones, they have been thoroughly removed.
The Shroud grants power to not only the Fell, but to whoever drinks from this flask.
A simple meal, granting a lasting Melee Damage boost upon consumption. It tastes better in combination with other things, though.
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
If pure, cooked rice is a bit too plain for you, then this fried rice might satisfy your needs. The added egg breaks up the granular texture of the rice, and the vegetables create a punch of flavor!
A delicious jug of Frizzy Goat milk. Drinking it will grant you endurance.
A refreshing bowl of fruits with positive health benefits.
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
Fresh ginger, perfect for brewing hot tea to keep any cold at bay.
A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
